text:
This lilac sheds its petals.
+
+Out of itself it falls
+
+and hides its ancient shadow.
+
+I shall die of things like this.

translation.title: This Lilac Sheds Its Petals…
translation.editorial_note: Desde sí misma becomes out of itself, preserving the flower’s self-originating fall and the speaker’s fatal susceptibility to such small transformations.
